historical_record.description: The two lots, with a combined 51-foot frontage and about 6,300 square feet sloping up some 40 feet from the street, were vacant; an apartment building once proposed for the site had never been built. The City Planning Commission found the City's acquisition of the two vacant lots for a mini-park in conformity with the Master Plan.
